title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Enhanced Radiometer Image Precipitation Estimation using Conditional Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.01890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep generative networks have recently achieved unprecedented performance in precise image and video editing using sophisticated textual prompts. However, the effectiveness of such models heavily depends on access to very large supervised and annotated image datasets, which can be very difficult to obtain. This is particularly true for satellite instruments, which very rarely overlap with labelled data, and suffer from domain shifts in the rare occasions they do. In this paper, we investigate the potential of flow matching models for unsupervised domain adaptation of satellite radiometer images. Our main contribution is a novel unsupervised method that achieves precise domain alignment by leveraging parts of the deterministic ordinary differential equations in flow matching models, conditioned on different satellite instruments. translated_title: 使用条件流匹配实现无监督域自适应以增强辐射计图像降水估计
translated_abstract: 深度生成网络近来在使用复杂文本提示进行精确图像和视频编辑方面取得了前所未有的性能。然而，此类模型的有效性很大程度上依赖于获取大规模有监督且有标注的图像数据集，而这些数据集往往难以获得。对于卫星仪器而言尤其如此：卫星数据极少与标注数据重合，且在罕见重合的情况下还存在域偏移问题。本文研究了流匹配模型在卫星辐射计图像无监督域自适应中的潜力。我们的主要贡献是一种新颖的无监督方法，通过利用流匹配模型中确定性常微分方程的部分机制，并以不同卫星仪器为条件，实现精确的域对齐。该方法的一个关键优势在于能够在任意域之间进行自适应转换的同时保留关键信息。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于条件流匹配的无监督域自适应新方法，利用流匹配模型中的确定性常微分方程并以不同卫星仪器为条件实现辐射计图像间的精确域对齐，从而在保留关键信息的同时增强降水估计性能。
